card.name: Word endings after Le, long, lung
card.fires_on: The ending piece of a split word, such as 'es' in lunges, 'ung' in the name Leung, or 'ed'/'en' after 'long'. It also fires on 'ang' or 'tang' inside foreign or plant names.

modes.label: Ending of lunge or Leung

modes.label: Ang inside names
modes.description: The 'ang' piece within foreign names or seaweed synonyms.
modes.example: Black-tang, bladder, bladder fucus, bladderwrack, Blasen-t<<ang>>, brown algae
